verdicts.reason: A: very wide banner with tiny, illegible body, legal and URL text. The subhead is microscopic and cramped under the headline. The URL is jammed beside the CTA. A large empty right column holds only tiny text, so the hierarchy is broken and the layout is unbalanced. B: logo is shrunk but intact, and the headline is large and clear with a readable left-to-right flow. The subhead wraps awkwardly, with orphans like 'virtual' and 'challenges?'. The CTA is stacked into a narrow 5-line column that is hard to read. The right-hand text is tiny and the layout is crowded and edge-tight, so it is still flawed, but clearly better than A.
